art_direction.medium: editorial geometric illustration with credible adult proportions
art_direction.scene: An original pastel illustration depicts a fictional fully clothed adult standing with one foot on a broad low volume and the other on a positive foothold across a shallow corner. Large mint handholds provide relaxed support while the climber shifts the hips gently over the front shoe. The stance is moderate and grounded, without a forced split or suspended body. Use a wide oblique view showing the entire adult, both adjoining wall faces, and thick continuous crash mats. Chalky peach, deep plum, and sage pigments create soft hand-drawn edges. Keep adult anatomy and contact points credible; the landing is empty. Exclude words, brands, jumping, and high exposure.
